tasks.label: lab2 tests
args:
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p build
objs=()
for src in src/*.cpp; do
  base=$(basename "$src" .cpp)
  sym=$(printf '%s' "$base" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9' '_')
  clang++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -Dmain="main_${sym}" -c "$src" -o "build/${sym}.o"
  objs+=("build/${sym}.o")
done
tests=()
for test in tests/*.cpp; do
  base=$(basename "$test" .cpp)
  sym=$(printf '%s' "$base" | tr -c 'A-Za-z0-9' '_')
  clang++ -std=c++17 -Iinclude -I/opt/homebrew/include -c "$test" -o "build/${sym}.o"
  tests+=("build/${sym}.o")
done
clang++ "${objs[@]}" "${tests[@]}" -L/opt/homebrew/lib -lgtest_main -lgtest -pthread -o build/lab2_tests
./build/lab2_tests
